verdict.rationale: Kick provides documented MCP connectors (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, custom tools) and a CLI that let users query transactions, generate reports, categorize, and execute bookkeeping changes via natural language, explicitly stated as 'ask it to look things up, make changes, and run reports using natural language.' This is corroborated across multiple first-party docs pages and works alongside AI categorization/rules automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP/CLI natural-language experience beyond vendor docs, and no evidence of a public OpenAPI spec confirming full programmatic parity.
